subject: Project Proposal - Revised Version
body:
Hi Shirin,

Could you please send me the revised version of the project proposal by Friday? Please make sure the resource estimates are updated as discussed in yesterday's meeting.

Thanks,
John

subject: Re: Project Proposal - Revised Version
body:
Hi John,

Sure, I'll update the resource estimates and send the revised proposal by Friday.

Regards,
Shirin

subject: Re: Project Proposal - Revised Version
body: Thanks, Shirin. One more thing - please include the updated delivery timeline in the final version.
